objectives: Students will be able to discuss what will be gained from the study of personal finance.
Students will be able to describe the goals of financial planning.
Students will be able to forecast interest rates, inflation, and the state of the economy.
Students will be able to examine careers and other key factors that affect income.
Students will be able to explain how to plan financially over one's lifetime.
Students will be able to review types of financial records and statements pertinent to success in personal financial management.
Students will be able to review all phases of personal income taxation.
Students will be able to discuss the specifics of managing expenditures.
topics: Orientation; importance of personal finance Financial planning Managing taxes Budgeting and cash flow management Managin
